title: Keto Moroccan Stew
description: A hearty, one-pot dish featuring lentils, vegetables, and a blend of Moroccan spices. This stew is low in carbs, making it a great option for a keto diet.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomato paste, and bone broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the sliced sellou and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
